exclusion_list.name: MCP2_a
exclusion_list.reason: Ninapro usage notes: 'Sensor 11 (which corresponds to MCP2-3_A) was not included into the calibrated data due to noise problems.'  The released angles[:,5] column is all NaN.

exclusion_list.name: CMC5
exclusion_list.reason: the released CMC5 column is an exact linear function (slope 0.28511, matching the published 0.285) of the SAME raw column that feeds WRIST_F.  In the wrist flexion anchor both move by exactly the same raw amount (+9.96 counts, 37/37); in the wrist extension anchor both move by -19.41 counts (37/37).  One raw sensor cannot be both the palmar arch and the wrist.  In the fist anchor CMC5 does not move at all (19/18).

exclusion_list.name: MCP5_a
exclusion_list.reason: the released polynomial is not reproduced from the published coefficients.

exclusion_list.name: DIP3
exclusion_list.reason: on an unambiguous fist (Exercise B movements 6 and 17) the raw DIP3 gauge DECREASES in 35 of 37 subjects and the released DIP3 angle decreases with it, while in the very same segments every MCP and PIP flexion channel increases. The transform is faithful; the direction contradicts the official 'DIP(2-5)_F Flexion+/Extension-' criterion.

exclusion_list.name: DIP5
exclusion_list.reason: the same inversion, coherent in 32 of 37 subjects, raw response 11 % of the flexion-channel median.

inconclusive_list.name: CMC1_f
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: no pre-declared physical anchor in Exercise B for this channel

inconclusive_list.name: CMC1_a
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: no pre-declared physical anchor in Exercise B for this channel

inconclusive_list.name: PIP3
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: PIP3 responds to a fist in only 20 of 37 subjects, with a raw magnitude 8 % of the flexion-channel median; its raw and released-angle behaviour are mutually consistent, but the physical anchor is not reproduced.

inconclusive_list.name: MCP4_a
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: released MCP4_a and the raw abduction gauge move in OPPOSITE directions in 37 of 37 subjects on the abduction anchor, and three of its six published polynomial coefficients are not reproduced in the release.

inconclusive_list.name: PIP4
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: responds to a fist in 28 of 37 subjects.

inconclusive_list.name: DIP2
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: responds in the CORRECT direction (28 of 37), unlike DIP3/DIP4/DIP5.

inconclusive_list.name: DIP4
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: the same inversion, but coherent in only 28 of 37 subjects and with a raw response 11 % of the flexion-channel median.

inconclusive_list.name: WRIST_F
inconclusive_list.missing_evidence: the wrist-flexion and wrist-extension anchors both pass at 37/37, so the channel's physical behaviour is sound; the only defect is that its released quadratic coefficient differs from the published one.

zero_definition: the subject's own raw gauge values over the central part of Exercise B movement 11 (hand resting on the table, fingers together and extended); the released angles are f(glove) - f(glove_reference)
sign_convention: as published in the DB9 paper Table 6 (flexion positive for MCP/PIP/IP/CMC5/WRIST_F; fingers separated positive for the relative abductions)
raw_to_released_transform: recovered exactly by this lane; see artifacts/VERDICTS.json .A_transform_forms
